column1: # Documentary-support ledger for the quantitative claims PROTOCOL.md attributes
# to its citations ("Grounded in research"). Checked by
# scripts/check-claim-support.sh.
# Three different statements, kept apart on purpose:
#   1. The source EXISTS              -- scripts/check-citations.sh (identifier
#                                        resolves, title matches).
#   2. The source SAYS what we cite   -- this ledger (documentary support).
#   3. What the source says is TRUE   -- certified by no tool in this
#                                        repository, and never implied by 1-2.
# A real paper cited for a figure it does not state is the failure case 1
# cannot see: the identifier resolves, the title matches, and the claim is
# still unsupported.
# Columns (TAB-separated):
#   claim_id  citation  claim_text  status  source_version  locator  checked_on  method  note
# citation:       surname as in scripts/citations.tsv
# claim_text:     verbatim substring of PROTOCOL.md (checked)
# status:         SUPPORTED | PARTIAL | NOT_SUPPORTED | CONTRADICTED | NOT_CHECKED
#   SUPPORTED     the located passage states the claim as worded
#   PARTIAL       the figures are stated, but the wording adds, drops or shifts
#                 something (scope, modality, framing) -- note says what
#   NOT_SUPPORTED the located passage does not state it        -> check FAILS
#   CONTRADICTED  the located passage states something else     -> check FAILS
#   NOT_CHECKED   no passage located yet; visible debt, not an exemption
# source_version: e.g. arXiv:2603.22582v1 -- what was actually read
# locator:        where in that version (abstract / section / table)
# method:         how it was read (API endpoint or page), not from memory
# Abstract-level support is the floor: a figure found in an abstract is
# stated there; the full text was not audited unless the locator says so.
